body.statement: Counting vertex covers in a bipartite graph is \(\#\mathrm P\)-complete.

source.verbatim_statement: Also shown to be # P-complete are counting vertex covers in a bipartite graph, counting antichains in a partial order, and approximating the probability that a graph is connected and the probability that a pair of vertices is connected.

attestation.note: Literal primary-source transcription from the publisher abstract at DOI 10.1137/0212053, accessed 2026-09-13.

body.justification: This is the classical source problem for the width-preserving causal counting reduction.
body.gap: The causal ADMG construction and the exact success bijection are proved in this note.
body.consumer: It supplies the sole external hardness premise for the counting theorem.
